import hashlib,json,os,platform,sys
from pathlib import Path
from importlib.metadata import version
from gunicorn.app.wsgiapp import WSGIApplication
reference=json.loads(Path('qa380-reference.json').read_text());marker=json.loads(Path('qa380-marker.json').read_text())
files={n:{'bytes':len((b:=Path(n).read_bytes())),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()} for n in reference['files']};assert files==reference['files']
phase=sys.argv[1];sys.argv=['gunicorn','qa380_app:app'];g=WSGIApplication()
v={'marker':marker,'phase':phase,'python':platform.python_version(),'gunicorn':version('Gunicorn'),'flask':version('Flask'),'files':files,'forwarded_allow_ips_present':'FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS' in os.environ,'forwarded_allow_ips_env':os.environ.get('FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS'),'forwarded_allow_ips_config':g.cfg.forwarded_allow_ips,'gunicorn_cmd_args':os.environ.get('GUNICORN_CMD_ARGS'),'preload_app':g.cfg.preload_app,'accesslog':g.cfg.accesslog,'bind':g.cfg.bind,'port':os.environ.get('PORT')}
Path('qa380-'+phase+'.json').write_text(json.dumps(v));print('QA380_OBSERVER '+json.dumps(v,separators=(',',':')),flush=True)

import json,os
from pathlib import Path
from flask import jsonify,request,redirect,url_for
from app import app
from ipaddress import ip_address
marker=json.loads(Path('qa380-marker.json').read_text())

@app.get('/qa380/info')
def qa380_info():
 return jsonify(marker=marker,scheme=request.scheme,is_https=request.is_secure,
  url_root=request.url_root,url=request.url,
  done_url=url_for('qa380_done',_external=True),
  immediate_peer_is_loopback=ip_address(request.remote_addr).is_loopback,
  forwarded_proto=request.headers.get('X-Forwarded-Proto'),
  runtime=json.loads(Path('qa380-runtime.json').read_text()),
  build=json.loads(Path('qa380-build.json').read_text()))

@app.get('/qa380/redirect')
def qa380_redirect():return redirect(url_for('qa380_done',_external=True),code=302)

@app.get('/qa380/done')
def qa380_done():return jsonify(marker=marker,result='done',scheme=request.scheme)

@app.get('/qa380/https')
def qa380_https():
 if not request.is_secure:return redirect(request.url.replace('http://','https://',1),code=302)
 return jsonify(marker=marker,result='https-correct',scheme=request.scheme)

QA380_APP_SOURCE
pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements.txt
python qa380-observer.py build
commands.start: python qa380-observer.py runtime && exec gunicorn qa380_app:app
